run_with_substituted_path: run a program with PATH replaced by the SUBST_PATH environment variable value
run_subprocess_with_args: run a subprocess using sys.argv arguments and wait for it to complete
handle_signal_exit_code: handle negative exit codes from signals by converting them to exit code 100
review_main_function: review the main function that substitutes PATH and executes a subprocess with argument forwarding
summarize_run_with_path: summarize the run_with_path script that overrides PATH via SUBST_PATH env var before running a command
